# Crux Resolve LLC

> Crux Resolve LLC is a veteran-owned small business in Illinois, USA, building wireless serial connectivity hardware and specialized mobile software for automotive, embedded, industrial, and legacy systems. GhostBridge is the company's local WiFi-to-RS232 hardware family, and GhostTune is its mobile ECU tuning software.

Official website: https://cruxresolve.com/
Support: https://cruxresolve.com/support.html
Contact: support@cruxresolve.com

## GhostBridge

GhostBridge is the Crux Resolve wireless serial connectivity hardware family.

- Current product page: https://cruxresolve.com/ghostbridge.html
- WiFi serial device server solution page: https://cruxresolve.com/wifi-serial-device-server.html
- General RS232 over WiFi guide: https://cruxresolve.com/rs232-wifi.html
- OEM and custom-firmware inquiries: https://cruxresolve.com/oem-serial-solutions.html
- GhostBridge v1.0 / GB-01 is the currently available assembled product.
- GB-01 is a local standard 3-wire RS232-to-WiFi TCP bridge with a DB9 male RS232 interface and USB-C power.
- DB9 pinout on current GB-01: pin 2 RX, pin 3 TX, pin 5 GND.
- Current GB-01 does not route RTS/CTS, DTR/DSR, DCD, RI, or other modem-control lines to the DB9 connector.
- Default local TCP endpoint: 192.168.4.1:35000.
- GB-01 creates its own local WiFi access point and does not require a router, internet connection, cloud relay, or subscription to move serial data.
- GB-01 acts as a transparent TCP-to-RS232 transport and does not itself interpret the application protocol.
- A compatible non-automotive device should use true RS232 signaling, a compatible pinout/cable, three-wire TX/RX/GND communication, supported serial settings, and host software able to use TCP or a suitable TCP-to-virtual-COM layer.
- A DB9 connector alone does not establish compatibility; some DB9 equipment uses other electrical interfaces or nonstandard pinouts.
- GhostTune with MicroSquirt hardware running MS2/Extra 3.4.4 is the currently published verified automotive application.
- Crux Resolve can evaluate application-specific GhostBridge firmware behavior, serial/network defaults, repeat deployments, integration requirements, and future hardware needs case by case. The OEM page does not imply that every requested function can be implemented on the existing GB-01 hardware.

## GhostTune

GhostTune is an independent ECU tuning application for iPhone and iPad published by Crux Resolve LLC.

- Current product page: https://cruxresolve.com/ghosttune-app.html
- Apple App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6778061607
- Current verified ECU configuration: MicroSquirt hardware running MS2/Extra 3.4.4.
- Live ECU communication uses a compatible local WiFi-to-RS232 bridge.
- Core functions include VE, ignition, and AFR table editing, live ECU data, tune-file management and backups, diagnostics, guarded temporary writes, permanent burns, and read-back verification.
- Demo Mode can be used without a connected ECU.
- Only ECU configurations explicitly listed by Crux Resolve should be treated as supported.

## Brand and relationship notes

Crux Resolve LLC is the company and publisher/manufacturer. GhostBridge and GhostTune are separate product families owned by Crux Resolve.

GhostTune and GhostBridge are independent products. References to MicroSquirt, MegaSquirt, MS2/Extra, Apple, iPhone, iPad, iOS, or App Store identify compatible or relevant third-party products, platforms, or trademarks and do not imply endorsement or affiliation.
